create_associative_memory_bank: create an AssociativeMemoryBank instance with a sentence embedder and optional duplicate allowance
add_memory_entry: add a text entry to the associative memory bank using the add method
retrieve_associative_memories: retrieve the top k most semantically similar memories using cosine similarity on a query string
retrieve_recent_memories: retrieve the k most recently added memories from the associative memory bank
scan_memories_with_selector: scan the memory bank and return entries matching a boolean selector function
